changes: New: Big Wheel added to the Games list — a real Big Six money wheel, 54 segments at true casino odds (1 pays 1:1, 2 pays 2:1, 5 pays 5:1, 10 pays 10:1, 20 pays 20:1, the rare Joker pays 40:1). Bet on multiple values at once, tap Spin, one outcome settles everything. Reuses Daily Spin's wheel-and-pointer mechanics with its own felt/rail table, no-limit chip stacking, croupier lines, and a recent-spins history strip.

New: Sic Bo added to the Games list — three dice, one roll, every bet settles fresh each time. Big/Small, Totals (4-17 at real odds up to 60:1), Single Number, Specific Double, Specific Triple, and Any Triple. Reuses the 3D dice cube, felt/rail table, and no-limit chip stacking built for Craps. Fixed the Big Win modal to correctly show all three dice on a Sic Bo win.

New: Player status tiers — Bronze/Silver/Gold/Platinum/Diamond, a custom gem badge (not emoji medals, which clashed with the leaderboard's own rank medals) combining Casino Lifetime XP, the betting board's Season Score, and cumulative Tipping points into one Prestige Score. Shows on the Casino leaderboard, the Tipping ladder, the Board leaderboard, profile cards, Hold'em seats, and table chat. A bad week never subtracts — only good results add.

New: Tier-up celebration — crossing into a new tier now pops a proper celebration with confetti, checked after any Casino win, a Tipping ladder update, or a Board leaderboard result. Fires once per tier, tracked server-side.
New: a Form Guide card on the Home tab — Tipping ladder leader, hottest Casino win streak, the standout individual bet win, and who's been most active at the tables this month.
New: Win streaks — 3+ wins in a row across any single-player Casino game shows a flickering flame badge on the leaderboard plus a toast the moment you hit it.
New: Session recap — leaving a Casino game shows hands played, net XP, and biggest win for that session.
New: Craps got Take Down / Let It Ride / Press for Place and Hardway wins, plus a bordered One-Roll Props panel with Any 7 as its own red banner row.

New: Craps built as a full high-roller table — Pass Line, Don't Pass, Come, Don't Come, Field, Odds, Place, Hardways, Props — real 3D dice cube, felt/rail table with MLSYND CASINO watermark, casino chip-token bet display.

New: Croupier table-talk on Roulette, Craps, Blackjack, Sic Bo, and Big Wheel — dealer-voice captions at the moments that matter. New: 'last 10 outcomes' history strips on Blackjack, Baccarat, and Casino War.

Fixed: minimum bet lowered to 5 XP on Blackjack, Baccarat, and Casino War — a leftover 10 XP check was silently rejecting the 5 XP chip. Fixed: no house limit on Roulette or Craps — chips now stack by tapping (250 x4 = 1000 XP) instead of only setting a single denomination, and every chip readout across the whole Casino can be tapped to type any custom amount.

Fixed: several real double-tap races across Casino — a fast double-tap on the main action button could debit a bet or claim a reward twice. Fixed on Blackjack, Casino War, Baccarat, Roulette, Daily Spin, Craps, and Challenges (Accept/Send).

Fixed: Hold'em tables with no recorded creator (old test tables) could never show a Delete button for anyone — now deletable by any signed-in member. Fixed: Hold'em's Stand Up/Sit Out buttons could silently fail to respond (a live-update DOM race). Fixed: the hand's own winner could see 'Spectating' at showdown despite everyone else seeing their cards — showdown now shows a proper result banner with mini cards and a trophy on your own win.

Fixed: Tipping's background refresh could silently wipe a pick or an in-progress margin entry. Fixed: Craps and Sic Bo now correctly feed the Monthly Casino Pot (a gap in the reason-text pattern missed Craps entirely at first).

Fixed: the win-streak feature was writing to a Firebase path with no rule allowing it — streaks were almost certainly never actually saving. Fixed alongside a new rule for the tier system's tipping-points cache.

Polish: brass rail bezel extended to Blackjack, Baccarat, Casino War, Video Poker, and Challenges' hand view, matching Roulette/Craps/Sic Bo/Big Wheel/Hold'em. A 5 XP chip added to every chip rail across the Casino. Baccarat's Banker bet no longer takes a commission — pays 1:1 same as Player. Live-win flash ticker threshold raised 300→500 XP.

Polish: Lifetime XP shown on the Casino leaderboard and profile cards. A Casino XP teaser added to the Home tab. Sport/News dropdowns and Tipping's round selector now match the app's dark/brass input styling. Home tab's individual bet amount colors by actual Win/Loss result, not the sign of the dollar figure.

Ledger app: fixed the Bettor Rotation panel — a win no longer wrongly auto-ticks the SGM checkbox (a separate, unrelated promo). A win now auto-adds a genuine second bet row instead, which correctly counts toward the tally.
